newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar trade closed for holidays.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar trade closed for holidays.

text.p: India's sugar trade was closed on Tuesday for the traditional Hindu New Year festival, dealers said. The markets reopen on Wednesday.
The markets were also closed on Monday for the New Year.
On the last trading day on Friday, sugar lost some of its recent gains as wholesale festival buying for the weekend's Diwali festival ended, dealers said.
S-30 fell by five rupees to 1,290/1,325l while M-30 eased by eight rupees to 1,320/1,365. Arrivals remained higher on fresh offerings by the mill owners.
Sugar mill delivery fell to 1,195/1,1210 from 1,200/1,220.
